Steph / team — thanks for the ping and forwarding Lily's redlines. High-level recommendations after reviewing ClientCo_DPA_redlines_v1 (see attached response matrix):

1) Subprocessors / opt-in: push back on any "opt-in" approval model that creates a per-subprocessor approval right. Offer:
   - We accept advance notice of changes (30 days) and an objection right limited to reasonable security/privacy concerns with a short dispute resolution/mitigation path.
   - For analytics/managed embeddings, propose a Category-level opt-out rather than per-vendor approval; that keeps operational cadence sane.

2) KMS / customer-managed keys: operationally we support customer-managed keys for Redwood Private and Dedicated tiers. For Hosted (our standard plan) we can offer a KMS-backed encryption-at-rest commitment and document key handling, but cannot provide full customer-managed key rotation for hosted tenants. Proposed language: include option for customer-managed keys for Enterprise/Dedicated with a defined onboarding lead time and additional fees.

3) Retention / backups: 24 months is fine for backups in many cases but we should carve out legal hold and logs required for security investigations. Propose: backup retention default of 12 months with option to extend to 24 months by request (and documented in SOW). Also add explicit deletion procedures post-termination with certification where feasible.

4) EU transfers / SCCs: Redwood relies on the EU SCCs framework and maintains an EU data processing addendum for accounts with EU data. We'll confirm the standard addendum and provide it as an attachment. If ClientCo insists on an alternative transfer mechanism, that will require legal ops review and potential Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA).

5) Audit / evidence requests: limit frequency and scope; provide Redacted reports and SOC2 attestations rather than on-site audits except for Dedicated/Private.

Attached: Redwood_DPA_response_matrix_v1.xlsx (matrix mapping each ClientCo redline to recommended stance + replacement language). I marked items we can accept, items that need alternate language, and items requiring product/infra confirmation (KMS, retention).

Next steps: Steph — can you confirm whether ClientCo is on Hosted or Dedicated to firm up the KMS position? If Hosted, we will propose the enterprise option language. I'll prepare proposed language for the subprocessor clause and SCCs addendum, then we can push back via redline + track changes.

-Marissa

3) Proposed tradeoffs (to help expedite):
   - ClientCo: withdraw the per-subprocessor opt-in request and accept a category-level objection/notice model; Redwood: commit to 30-day notice + mitigation/dispute path.
   - ClientCo: allow for SCCs + Redwood EU Addendum as transfer mechanism; Redwood: supply signed addendum and SCC references.
   - ClientCo: accept backup retention 12 months default; Redwood: provide option to extend to 24 months via SOW.

If these are acceptable, we'll incorporate the changes into a single tracked-redline and route via DocuSign. Tentative DocuSign envelope (I'll populate once we have confirmed KMS/tier): https://app.docusign.com/envelope/ABC123456789
